parameters.name: MOD (MODWHEEL)
parameters.description: CC 1 (LSB CC 33), page 9: MOD (MODWHEEL). 7 bits: [0...127] = [min MOD...max MOD]. 14 bits: [0...16383] = [min MOD...max MOD].

parameters.name: RELEASE
parameters.description: CC 9 (LSB CC 41), page 9: RELEASE. 7 bits: [0...127] = [min RELEASE...max RELEASE]. 14 bits: [0...16383] = [min RELEASE...max RELEASE].

parameters.name: VIBR/GLIDE
parameters.description: CC 10 (LSB CC 42), page 9: VIBR/GLIDE. 7 bits: [0...63] = [max VIBR...min VIBR], [64...127] = [min ACCEL...max ACCEL]. 14 bits: [0...8192] = [max VIBR...min VIBR], [8193...16383] = [min ACCEL...max ACCEL].

parameters.name: MOD
parameters.description: CC 11 (LSB CC 43), page 9: MOD. 7 bits: [0...127] = [min MOD ..max MOD]. 14 bits: [0...16383] = [min MOD...max MOD].

parameters.name: ENGINE
parameters.description: CC 12 (LSB CC 44), page 9: ENGINE. 7 bits: [0...25] = [ENGINE 1: MOTOR], [26...51] = [ENGINE 2: MxD], [52...76] = [ENGINE 3: MWAVE], [77...102] = [ENGINE 4: COIL], [103...127] = [ENGINE 5: VOCODER],. 14 bits: [0...3276] = [ENGINE 1: MOTOR], [3277...6553] = [ENGINE 2: MxD], [6554...9829] = [ENGINE 3: MWAVE], [9830...13106] = [ENGINE 4: COIL], [13107...16383] = [ENGINE 5: VOCODER],.

parameters.name: PEDAL
parameters.description: CC 13 (LSB CC 45), page 9: PEDAL. 7 bits: [0...25] = [PEDAL MODE 1: ACCEL], [26...51] = [PEDAL MODE 2: BRAKE], [52...76] = [PEDAL MODE 3: CLUTCH], [77...102] = [PEDAL MODE 4: DRIFT], [103...127] = [PEDAL MODE 5: VOLUME],. 14 bits: [0...3276] = [PEDAL MODE 1: ACCEL], [3277...6553] = [PEDAL MODE 2: BRAKE], [6554...9829] = [PEDAL MODE 3: CLUTCH], [9830...13106] = [PEDAL MODE 4: DRIFT], [13107...16383] = [PEDAL MODE 5: VOLUME],.

parameters.name: PEDAL VALUE
parameters.description: CC 15 (LSB CC 47), page 9: PEDAL VALUE. 7 bits: [0...127] = [off ... fully pressed (normal range)]. 14 bits: [0...16383] = [off ... fully pressed (normal range)].

parameters.name: FLOOR-IT VALUE
parameters.description: CC 16 (LSB CC 48), page 9: FLOOR-IT VALUE. 7 bits: [0...127] = [pressed...max pressure (floor-it)]. 14 bits: [0...16383] = [pressed...max pressure (floor-it)].

parameters.name: MIDI NOTE ONLY MODE
parameters.description: CC 17 (LSB CC 49), page 9: MIDI NOTE ONLY MODE (disable instrument input pitchtracker e.g. for vocoding). 7 bits: [0...63] = OFF, [64...127] = ON. 14 bits: [0...8191] = OFF, [8192...16383] = ON.

parameters.name: PEDAL + PRESSURE VALUE
parameters.description: CC 18 (LSB CC 50), page 9: PEDAL + PRESSURE VALUE. 7 bits: [0...90] = [off...fully pressed (normal range)], [91...102] = [deadzone], [103...127] = [pressed...max pressure (floor-it)]. 14 bits: [0...11469] = [off...fully pressed (normal range)], [11470...13106] = [deadzone], [13107...16383] = [pressed...max pressure (floor-it)].

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/gamechanger/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/gamechanger/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a row of the document's MIDI CC table, on the channel variable. A row whose values sweep is sent in 14 bits, CC n and then its LSB, CC n + 32, as the table's header gives them; a row whose values are named one each is a choice, sent as its band's first 7-bit value on CC n alone, which the table's 7-bit column allows. Nothing here has been sent to a real pedal yet.
The table gives the modulation knob two controllers, CC 1 (the mod wheel) and CC 11; both are laid out, as printed.
